entities.summary: Adriana Lestido is an Argentine photographer. Her black and white photographs document the often difficult place of women in society. Lestido is the author of several books including Mujeres presas, Madres e hijas (2003), Interior (2010), La Obra (2011), Lo Que Se Ve (2012), and Metropolis (2022).
